pass: Distributed Failure, Compound-Fault & Recovery Correctness Verification

DIST-INV-01.name: Shared Authoritative State Wins Across Workers
DIST-INV-01.definition: Two workers acting on the same authoritative object must not both succeed when the contract permits only one transition. Process-local locks are insufficient proof.
DIST-INV-01.boundary: Authoritative persistence layer / CAS precondition check (update_conditional)
DIST-INV-01.oracle: success_count == 1 and conflict_count == 1 across concurrent workers

DIST-INV-02.name: Retry After Ambiguous Outcome Preserves Logical Identity
DIST-INV-02.definition: If the client cannot determine whether an operation committed, retry/recovery must not silently turn one intended operation into two business operations.
DIST-INV-02.boundary: IdempotencyService acquire/complete/replay lifecycle and durable case persistence
DIST-INV-02.oracle: request_attempts == 2, durable_business_objects == 1, cached response replayed with identical ID

DIST-INV-03.name: Partial FL Failure Cannot Corrupt the Global Model
DIST-INV-03.definition: Failed, malformed, non-finite, stale, or missing client updates must not partially corrupt a committed global aggregation round.
DIST-INV-03.boundary: FederatedLearningEngine parameter filtering and quarantine pipeline
DIST-INV-03.oracle: Quarantined non-finite/exception updates excluded; independent tensor oracle matches accepted-only aggregate

DIST-INV-04.name: Failed Round Cannot Masquerade as Successful Round
DIST-INV-04.definition: A round that does not satisfy its success contract must not advance model/version/evaluation state as though it succeeded.
DIST-INV-04.boundary: ModelRegistry version manifest and SimulationService round state machine
DIST-INV-04.oracle: Registry version remains N; serving model remains N; round status is FAILED; no half-committed version N+1

DIST-INV-05.name: Recovery Does Not Resurrect Stale Work
DIST-INV-05.definition: After worker/service restart, previously stale operations must not regain authority merely because process-local state disappeared.
DIST-INV-05.boundary: Worker restart lifecycle and durable version validation
DIST-INV-05.oracle: Fresh worker instance without process-local cache/lock rejects stale V1 operation against durable V2 state

DIST-INV-06.name: Compound Failure Preserves Truth
DIST-INV-06.definition: When two failures occur together, handling the first failure must not hide, bypass, or convert the second into a false success.
DIST-INV-06.boundary: Multi-fault handling pipeline (privacy budget exhaustion + client failure)
DIST-INV-06.oracle: Client failure does not bypass privacy budget check; system raises PrivacyBudgetExceededError and fails closed

DIST-INV-07.name: Durable State and External Side Effects Remain Distinguishable
DIST-INV-07.definition: Database success, event acknowledgement, webhook delivery, report generation, and similar effects are different facts. Recovery logic must not collapse them into one boolean notion of 'success.'
DIST-INV-07.oracle: Durable business entity count == 1, request attempts == 2, external transport notifications recorded distinctly

DIST-INV-08.name: Security Mechanisms Fail Closed Under Dependency Failure
DIST-INV-08.definition: A security/privacy mechanism that cannot execute must not silently downgrade to an unprotected path unless that fallback is an explicit, truthful, tested contract.
DIST-INV-08.oracle: Differential privacy and Byzantine defense refuse un-noised/plaintext aggregation under budget or invariant failure
